The '''Iyra gravity belt''' was a specialized [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]] created by [[Iyranis Gravitics Limited]], an [[Iyra]] company. In addition to the standard functions of a utility belt, the gravity belt included gravity pulse generators that saved its wearer from falls by slowing them down.<ref name="GFT" />
